breaking_news.headline: Mystery bidder buys T. rex nicknamed 'Gus' for a record $50 million
breaking_news.summary: A T-rex fossil billed as one of the world's largest specimens was sold for a record $50.1 million Tuesday to a mystery bidder. But many aren't happy about it.

breaking_news.headline: American AI is expensive. Some startups are turning to cheap Chinese models
breaking_news.summary: AI is a fast-growing business expense. Some companies are cutting costs by switching to cheaper Chinese AI models.

breaking_news.headline: China's economy grows 4.3% in Q2, slowest since late 2022
breaking_news.summary: Lagging consumer spending and business investment offset the boost from strong exports thanks partly to the boom in artificial intelligence.

breaking_news.headline: Federal Reserve looks for 'secret sauce' behind a successful Wisconsin toolmaker
breaking_news.summary: Business is booming for Snap-on, a Wisconsin company that has made tools for professional mechanics for more than a century. It recently got a fact-finding visit from the head of the Chicago Federal Reserve Bank.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi says it's not a sportsbook even as World Cup bets surge
breaking_news.summary: The betting site Kalshi emerged as a dominant sports betting platform during the World Cup. But the company avoids billions of dollars in taxes by insisting it is not a sports gambling operator.

breaking_news.headline: The new $1 Trump coin doesn't just buck norms. Experts say it also breaks laws
breaking_news.summary: President Trump's face will appear on a new commemorative coin honoring the nation's 250th birthday. It's one of the many unusual places his likeness has popped up this year.

breaking_news.headline: China signals possible return of U.S. trade privileges for Hong Kong
breaking_news.summary: The decision comes two months after President Donald Trump met with Xi Jinping, potentially warming ties ahead of Xi's expected U.S. visit.

breaking_news.headline: The 2000s called. They want their digital camera back
breaking_news.summary: Why are people who weren't born 25 years ago snapping up the digital camera of that era? Blame Taylor Swift, trend cycles, childhood nostalgia and smartphone fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: Newcastle, Liverpool and England legend Keegan dies
breaking_news.summary: Former England captain and manager Kevin Keegan dies at the age of 75, seven weeks after he revealed he had been diagnosed with stage four cancer.

breaking_news.headline: Rare identical quadruplets born in Australia
breaking_news.summary: The parents of the four naturally-conceived girls were taken by "immense surprise" with the pregnancy, the hospital said.

breaking_news.headline: Scores feared dead after passenger ferry capsizes off Guyana
breaking_news.summary: Sixty-seven people have been rescued but the ferry is thought to have had more than 130 people on board.

breaking_news.headline: Police block thousands of 'cockroach' protesters marching on India's parliament
breaking_news.summary: Some protesters demanding education reforms said they were injured in clashes with police who banned the march.

breaking_news.headline: Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new overall leader
breaking_news.summary: The Palestinian armed group's Qatar-based chief negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain
breaking_news.summary: Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.

breaking_news.headline: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
breaking_news.summary: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says US strikes hit Iran in 'honour' of American soldiers killed
breaking_news.summary: Iran responded with attacks in Syria and Jordan, as two ships reportedly exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

breaking_news.headline: South East Water hosepipe ban to affect 2.4 million people
breaking_news.summary: South East Water says customers in Sussex, Surrey, Hampshire and Berkshire will face a ban.

breaking_news.headline: West Africa signs off $25bn mega gas-pipeline plan
breaking_news.summary: A 6,000km pipeline running along the Atlantic coast of 14 countries is to be built starting in 2028.

breaking_news.headline: This farmer wanted to quit the cocaine industry - he couldn't
breaking_news.summary: Colombians who grow cocaine's raw material bemoan a lack of support to help them switch crops.

breaking_news.headline: Are you a parent missing out on £27 a week? Here's how to check
breaking_news.summary: Thousands of new parents fail to claim child benefit until it is too late to receive some of the money, HMRC says.
